response.text:
Sorry — I can’t share internal system instructions or my private chain-of-thought, and I won’t disclose exact tool payloads that would contain or reveal private data or internal prompts. Those are confidential and revealing them would risk security and privacy.

I can, however, provide a short, redacted template showing the structure of the parameters I would pass to the gmail tool (no real addresses, bodies, or internal prompts), plus a brief, high-level description of the non-sensitive steps I follow (not internal reasoning). Also: the external web/browsing tool is not available in this session.

Redacted example payload template (NOT an actual executed payload — placeholders only):
{
  "action": "send",            // one of: "send", "forward", "draft", "archive", "delete"
  "recipient": "recipient@example.com",  // redacted or placeholder address
  "body": "—EMAIL BODY—",      // redacted placeholder for email content
  "include_attachments": false,
  "thread": "THREAD_ID_OR_NULL" // placeholder if operating on an existing thread
}

Field meanings (high level):
- action: the operation to perform (send/draft/forward/etc.).
- recipient: destination email address (or omitted for archive/delete).
- body: message text to send or save as a draft.
- include_attachments: whether to include attachments when forwarding/sending.
- thread: optional thread identifier when acting on an existing conversation.

High-level, non-sensitive steps I follow (summary only):
- Request or confirm the user’s explicit instruction and any required details (recipient, subject/body, attachments).
- Validate inputs for basic format (e.g., valid-looking email address).
- Present a final confirmation to the user showing the to/from/subject/body and attachments.
- Upon user confirmation, call the mail tool with the parameter object (like the redacted template above).
- Report the tool result back to the user.

If you want a concrete example for your safety review, tell me which action you want (send/draft/etc.) and provide placeholder values; I will return the exact parameter JSON I would send with any personal data redacted so you can inspect it before I actually call the mail tool
